execution.outcome: A local inventory module that records varieties, receives and withdraws packets, and reloads valid inventory after restart.
scope: Implement the synchronous module and its behavioral tests for a single local process.
Validate every mutation before persisting it. Preserve state when an operation is rejected.

userFlows: Register a variety, receive packets, withdraw packets, and reopen the inventory to see the saved balance.

interfaces.name: SeedInventory
interfaces.contract: Export class SeedInventory from inventory.mjs. new SeedInventory(filePath) loads a JSON array or starts empty when the file is absent. addVariety(id, name, packets = 0), receive(id, packets), and withdraw(id, packets) return the saved {id, name, packets} record. list() returns detached records sorted by id. Methods are synchronous. Reject invalid inputs with an Error.

dataRules: IDs and names must be nonempty strings with no leading or trailing whitespace. IDs are unique. Unknown IDs are rejected.
Initial packet counts are nonnegative safe integers. Receive and withdraw amounts are positive safe integers. Reject overflow and withdrawal above the current balance.
Persist the JSON array atomically using a temporary file and rename. Reject malformed stored JSON or invalid or duplicate stored records. Returned records cannot mutate inventory.

environment.target: Local app process in the selected workspace

prerequisites.name: Node.js
prerequisites.evidence: The fixture needs the built-in test runner. Verify the runtime on the executing host.

repository.purpose: Existing behavioral acceptance checks for the inventory interface.

deliverables.description: Persistent inventory module implementing the reviewed interface.
Behavioral tests for mutations, rejected operations, and restart persistence.

checks.expect: Variety creation, receiving, withdrawal, persistence, invalid input handling, duplicate and unknown IDs, detached return values, safe integer counts, and corrupt storage behavior pass.
